question: Find the incorrect part of the sentence: He as well as his brothers were present.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence is "**He as well as his brothers**," which is singular because the phrase "as well as" does not make the subject plural.
 
• The verb "**were**" is incorrect as it is plural. A singular verb like "**was**" should be used instead.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He as well as his brothers **was** present."*
